methodology.district_sampling: enrollment^0.5 weighted, with 12% (public) / 45% (pro) roam off the user's own district
methodology.grading: A=every required field resolves; B=partial with a documented substitute; C=data never collected; D=data held but no surface exposes it
methodology.absence_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE and DID_NOT_HAPPEN count as answered; NOT_MEASURED does not

fund_balance.fix: Ingest TEA's Actual Financial Report fund-balance file.

campus_finance.evidence: campus_data.json carries rating, score, students, pct_poor — no dollars. Every financial figure in this repo stops at the district.
campus_finance.fix: TAPR campus files (already the named next fountain in CLAUDE.md).

campus_staff.evidence: Teacher turnover/experience/salary exist only at district level (outcomes measures); campus records hold no staff fields.

teacher_certification.evidence: No certification field in any artefact.

staar_by_grade.evidence: equity_data.json holds district totals by subject (reading/math) only — no grade level.
staar_by_grade.fix: TEA STAAR district file at grade grain (currently login-gated).

staar_by_race.evidence: other_groups covers emergent_bilingual and special_ed only.

campus_staar.evidence: Equity layer is district-grain; campus layer has ratings, not scores by subject.

salaries_named.evidence: No individual-salary or superintendent-pay field anywhere.
salaries_named.fix: TEA superintendent salary file / district AFRs.

vendor_contracts.evidence: No payables, vendor, or contract data ingested.
vendor_contracts.fix: Per-district check registers — no statewide publisher exists.

bond_projects.evidence: bond elections carry date/amount/purpose CATEGORY/vote counts — no project list, no spend-against-bond.
bond_projects.fix: District bond project pages; no statewide source.

budget_forward.evidence: Every finance figure is ACTUAL (PEIMS actuals, fiscal 2009-2025). No adopted budget, no current-year figure.
budget_forward.fix: Ingest adopted budgets, or state clearly that the site is historical.

enrollment_forecast.evidence: No projection model. trend series ends at the last actual year.
enrollment_forecast.fix: A demographic model — and an error bar, or it should not ship.

state_aid_formula.evidence: Revenue is split local/state/federal only. No FSP allotment detail, no basic allotment, no tier composition.

tax_rate_history.evidence: economics districts[*].tax holds ONE year. Rate history exists only as a statewide macro series, not per district.
tax_rate_history.fix: Comptroller per-district rate history (already partly ingested statewide).

parcel_tax.evidence: Tax bill is modelled on a fixed $300,000 home, stated as such. No appraisal roll, no individual property.
parcel_tax.fix: Out of scope — county appraisal districts, 254 of them.

attendance_zones.evidence: district_geo.json holds DISTRICT boundaries only (1,016). No campus attendance zones.
